name: How long does engineered hardwood flooring installation take?
description: Installation time varies by area size, subfloor condition, and method, typically 1-3 days per room. Subfloor prep can extend the timeline.

mainEntity.name: How long does engineered hardwood flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of engineered hardwood flooring installation depends on factors such as the area size, subfloor preparation required, and the chosen installation method. Generally, a typical room can take 1-3 days. Extensive subfloor leveling or moisture mitigation can add significant time to the project. Before installation begins, Hometelligent Inc. conducts a thorough site assessment to provide a realistic timeline tailored to your specific home in areas like Alameda or Berkeley, ensuring transparency from the start.
